accounting.rationale: Original PDF126 lines10-11 defines deferred-shape arrays by the allocatable-array or array-pointer categories. No no-op program or initial-state observation is invented for the definition.
Allocatable is an attribute/category, not an assertion that allocation has occurred.
An array pointer is not necessarily associated. Its shape cannot be inferred from a declaration's colons.
The parenthetical attribute explanation does not turn every allocatable entity into an array; scalar and assumed-rank categories remain distinct.
A pointer attribute does not by itself establish array rank, a target, association status or target lifetime.
PDF126 line12 defines one colon; the list context is separately supplied by R814/R401 and the entity-role constraint.
PDF126 lines13-14 retains the array premise, both attributes and both declaration alternatives; it is not a blanket rule for every scalar/assumed-rank entity.
PDF126 lines16-18 combines undefined properties, a conditional part-reference/definition restriction and an intrinsic-inquiry permission. Undefined properties are not measured or trapped.
The stated inactive array states have no defined size to sample. RANK is a different declared property, and each inquiry has its own argument contract.
Do not infer lower/upper bounds from an unallocated or disassociated array descriptor, including empty-array defaults.
An unavailable shape is not an empty shape and is not authorized by known rank. No undefined-value execution oracle is added.

The explicit16.1 exception is retained in the qualified restriction. ALLOCATED/RANK and the state requirements of ASSOCIATED/LBOUND/UBOUND/SHAPE/SIZE differ; a normal helper call is not automatically an intrinsic inquiry.

PDF126 lines21-25 lists permitted pointer-bound specification mechanisms with association/dummy/target premises. They retain canonical allocation, pointer-assignment and argument owners; no new S requirement or no-op execution is created for this list.
PENDING an already established array-pointer association before any bounds/shape observation. A declaration or undefined association status supplies neither.
PENDING source-qualified literal bounds, extents and defined-value observations under the actual mechanism; no address, storage-width, descriptor-field or copying oracle.

The target is created by the pointer allocation. SOURCE/MOLD rank/type/state and initialization rules remain canonical; MOLD does not promise copied payload, and STAT or another allocate-object cannot supply a self-dependent bound.

PENDING a live compatible INTEGER target and direct assignment, plus a separately qualified explicit-lower-bound variant. Read10.2.2.3p8-p10 for remapping, rank/element-count premises and target LBOUND semantics; do not substitute scalar CHARACTER/PDT-parent cases for array-pointer bounds.

PENDING the INTENT(IN) pointer-dummy route with a valid live nonpointer target under15.5.2.8p2. Preserve15.5.2.4p5: this dummy is not argument associated with that nonpointer actual; it becomes pointer associated, and the actual must not be renamed an effective argument.

requirements.title: Inactive deferred-shape arrays cannot have parts referenced or defined, subject to inquiry permission
requirements.source: 8.5.8.4 p3 restriction and exception, physical PDF126, lines16-18
requirements.definition: No part of an unallocated allocatable array or disassociated array pointer is referenced or defined in that state. The array can occur as an intrinsic inquiry argument as permitted by16.1 and the particular intrinsic's description. Operations that first establish allocation/association, including conforming whole-allocatable assignment, are not forbidden attempts to define an unavailable element.

pending.unallocated-part-reference: PENDING source-only contrast for reading a(1) while a is unallocated, with a minimally repaired valid control that first allocates and defines that element, for example ALLOCATE(a(1),SOURCE=17). Do not execute the invalid read or demand a runtime trap; a rejection fixture requires a separately approved diagnostic policy.
pending.disassociated-part-reference: PENDING source-only contrast with explicitly NULLIFYed p and a live defined compatible TARGET array t already present. Replace NULLIFY(p) by p=>t for the valid read control. An undeclared/undefined association status is a different condition; no invalid read is executed.
pending.unavailable-part-definition: PENDING source-only a(1)=17 and p(1)=17 contrasts in the stated inactive states. The respective repairs establish allocation or live target association before that defining assignment. Distinguish an array element/section from whole-allocatable assignment that legitimately allocates first under10.2.1.3.
pending.specific-inquiry-permission: PENDING finite original contracts: ALLOCATED is for allocatables, RANK has its own permitted property inquiry, ASSOCIATED requires defined association status, and LBOUND/UBOUND/SHAPE/SIZE require allocation or association as specified. Use one-argument ASSOCIATED for zero-size target status; do not invent bounds, apply ALLOCATED to a pointer or promote this permission to an effect case.
pending.ordinary-call-and-state-source: PENDING actual/dummy presence and state relations. An unallocated allocatable actual can correspond to an allocatable dummy, but an ordinary nonallocatable nonoptional helper call does not become permitted merely because its body calls RANK. Pointer INTENT(OUT) undefines association, and allocatable INTENT(OUT) deallocates; no previous bounds may be sampled then.
